description: Source code for device information retrieval and network interface configuration, including functions to get device info values and cached network interface configurations.

methods.name: devinfo_getv
methods.description: Retrieves a device info value by executing an external script and caches the result.

methods.name: devinfo_get_inet_iface_config
methods.description: Provides cached network interface configuration (IP and MAC) for specified interfaces, handling only LAN and WAN bridge interfaces.
